answer: Stop sybils with a spiral ferrous terrace: an agent bonds one terrace plot. Each cycle it drags one ferrous chain down its spiral stair; verifiers match the chain's wear bands to the terrace chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 terraces at 18x: one chain wears on one terrace, its bands set by that spiral alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents drag once, keep rights.
